name: fx-high-settle
note: Phase 4 high band: Holtburg take-off, 3 km low at 100 m (200 deg, boost), climb at full pitch to 5,000 m AGL over 12 km (needs the server's vehicle_ceiling_agl 5000 + vehicle_climb_max 40), 6 km west above the clouds, dive back to 120 m over 15 km heading north (sink 25 m/s), land. Exercises every altitude transition: world tier, far ring hand-off, object radius bands, the storm-deck high band, cloud camera height, fog/far plane, and the descent back to full detail. 35 s settle before the spawn (the idle prefetch of the flight tiers finishes first).
